reviewType: Coordinator scoped biomarker construction assessment; not independent acceptance

findings.subject: Fictional normal-response model
findings.disposition: The current detection owner carries LoD95 at 2 and separately assumed LoQ8, but omits the exact Y|c normal model and its cumulative probability. SB28-P01 is unapplied; SB28-004 remains partial.
findings.source: Complete pinned construction brief and directly recomputed mathematical geometry; no clinical or assay-validation evidence is inferred.

findings.subject: Actual existing contributor ownership
findings.disposition: All three existing owners are actual unmerged PR371 records at the verified frozen head, absent from registered root and root generated exports. PR373 was not substituted. No duplicate or root record was authored.

findings.subject: Original and later teaching scope
findings.disposition: The absence parent adds an event-information/power clause and a distinct non-inferiority cross-reference later. Detection and prognostic teaching are unchanged. Shared confidence-parent reading and two views are reused only by exact identity.

findings.subject: Source access and reading depth
findings.disposition: Five complete returned abstracts, thirty complete targeted HTML paragraphs, five FDA PDF text pages, three CLSI sample pages, two raw glossary ranges and one complete NCI raw definition were read freshly. No whole paper, whole guidance or whole standard was read. BEST captures are unread CAPTCHA responses. The NCI public page is a shell; its official glossary API supplies the definition.

findings.subject: Custody and support roles
findings.disposition: Four scientific construction briefs and eight support bodies retain mapped dependencies. Body8 embeds reader alt identical to the owner at both pins. Historical candidate/preimage hashes, private receipts, search-extraction source checks, creator identities and PASS/approval claims are kept distinct from current pinned reads and source verification.

findings.subject: Equivalence and effect scales
findings.disposition: The existing fields distinguish equivalence bounds, non-inferiority permitted loss and nonsignificance. The fictional risk ratios and absolute differences are correctly scoped to their scale, without an interaction test or individual forecast. The native figures and their arithmetic agree.
